environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind a classic ELB with no additional middleware. Application listens on port 8080, ELB forwards TCP 80 -> 8080. No reverse proxy, no additional headers injected. Cookie flags: Secure=false, HttpOnly=false as set in code. No SameSite attribute configured.

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 t3.medium, Classic ELB (TCP passthrough)
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 80
config.cookie_config: as defined in application code (Secure=false, HttpOnly=false, no SameSite)
